walkthroughs.body_html:
For Na2SO4 + BaCl2 -> BaSO4 + 2NaCl:

Ionic: Ba^2+ + SO4^2- -> BaSO4.

Na+ and Cl- are spectators.

Oxidation = loss of electrons; reduction = gain.

Mg -> Mg^2+ + 2e- (oxidation).

O2 + 4e- -> 2O^2- (reduction).

Dalton (1803): solid sphere.

Thomson (1897): plum pudding.

Rutherford (1911): nuclear model from alpha scattering. Bohr (1913): shells.
